ownerLimited: the panel-frame SVG skeleton: one owner component that emits defs (glow / edge / glass gradients, clip path, glow filter) plus four stacked <stop> pairs, where the local stop offsets and opacities are only meaningful as pairs (panelStopOffset + panelStopOpacity, panelGlassStopOffset + panelGlassStopOpacity).

the SMIL animation pair: animate elements read attributeName / attributeValue, and the secondary text needs secondaryAttributeName / secondaryAttributeValue; the primary and secondary pairs must keep parallel names or the animation cross-wires.

the line-chart time axis: timeTickIndex / timeTickRatio / timeTickX and gridTickIndex / gridTickRatio / gridTickValue are two parallel tick ladders plus a hasTimeAxis boolean gate; renaming only one ladder would silently hide the time axis.

the navigation-button CSS custom-property contract: mainTextLeft / mainTextTop / secondaryTextLeft / secondaryTextTop feed --navigation-main-left/top and --navigation-secondary-left/top, and navigationTextLeft / navigationTextTop are the fallback bases for them (mainTextTop subtracts 18 * navigationUnitScale).

the content-unit scale: navigationUnitScale (100/64.36) and contentUnitScale from navigationContentUnitPx() are two different scales multiplying the same font-size values; the style sheet depends on both.

the navigation button element tree: navigationButtonElement (the .hb-navigation-button div) owns navigationIconElement (.hb-navigation-icon with a mask-image from navigationIconUrl), navigationTextElement (.hb-navigation-text), navigationMainTextElement (<strong>) and navigationSecondaryTextElement (<small>); class names in the stylesheet pin this tree.

the scene-mode view: sceneModeElement (button.hb-scene-mode), navigationButtonViewElement (the render() result of the navigation component) and the bindSceneMode call that needs both the element and the component properties.

newConcepts: the panel-frame presentation: a rounded glass panel rendered as inline SVG with three gradient defs (panelEdgeGradientElement, panelGlowGradientElement, panelGlassGradientElement), a clip path and a glow filter; the geometry is derived from innerFrameWidth / innerFrameHeight and the visual knobs are edgeStrokeWidth / edgeInset / edgeOpacity / panelGlowStrength / panelGlowSize / panelGlowRadius / panelGlowBlur.

the line-chart details panel: a scrollable details list beside the line chart whose axis labels are <span> units (unitLabelElement, axisLabelElement, timeAxisLabelElement) and whose series path is detailsChartPath with a movingDotElement that follows the pointer.

the exported content-unit helpers: unitsComponent / unitsRenderEnvironment plus navigationUnitsComponent / navigationUnitsRenderEnvironment and their two scales, exported so the 3D studio can size badges in the same unit as the page.

the navigation-button renderer: originally a bare short name Oe registered as the navigation button component's render; it builds and binds a navigation button view (main text, secondary text, icon, glow) from a component + render environment.
the scene-mode view: a button.hb-scene-mode holding a navigation component view, with bindSceneMode wiring clicks to scene actions (properties read from the scene mode component).
